name: Vertical Micro-Drama (Sutradara Mx-Shell 5-Stage)
description: Formula 5-Stage teruji (Zombie Scavenger/Mx-Shell): Hook 0-2s survive swipe, konfrontasi shot-reverse-shot, dan cliffhanger cut dramatis.
rules:
- 5-STAGE SKELETON: Core theme tags | Character & scene | Atmosphere & camera lens | Camera rules & breath float | Storyboard breakdown.
- HOOK (0-2s): Cold-open instan, selamat dari swipe. Aksi konfrontasi mendadak meledak di 2 detik awal tanpa prolog basa-basi.
- CONFRONTATION (2-8s): Shot-reverse-shot dialog tensi tinggi, slow push-in ke ekspresi wajah, tatapan mata tertahan (restrained emotion).
- CLIFFHANGER CUT (8-10s): Pemotongan di titik paling gantung (foto dibuka, rahasia terbongkar, atau langkah kaki mendekat).
- ANTI-SLOP & IMPERFECTION: Minimal 2 cacat alami (mata lelah, kerutan baju, noda kerah, lampu meja flickering). Hilangkan kata klise 'cinematic/4K'.
- CAMERA & ATMOSPHERE: ARRI Alexa dengan vintage primes (35mm f/2.8), framing vertikal 9:16 wajah di upper-middle, breath-like camera float, sound diegetik tanpa musik berisik.
